Package neqsim.pvtsimulation.regression

Class DepletionExperiment

java.lang.Object
neqsim.pvtsimulation.regression.DepletionExperiment
final class DepletionExperiment extends Object
Immutable isothermal depletion protocol with a bounded, model-local result cache shared by observation rows.

  • Constructor Details

    • DepletionExperiment

      DepletionExperiment(ExperimentType type, double[] pressures, double temperature, SystemInterface baseFluid, List<RegressionParameterConfig> configs)
      Freeze the full model, parameter identities and protocol for one registered experiment.
      Parameters:
      type - CVD or DLE
      pressures - ordered pressure schedule in bara
      temperature - isothermal temperature in K
      baseFluid - model snapshot before fitting
      configs - ordered fitting-parameter definitions

  • Method Details

    • validateSchedule

      static void validateSchedule(ExperimentType type, double[] pressures, double temperature)
      Validate a nonempty, nonincreasing depletion schedule without sorting or merging repeated rows.
      Parameters:
      type - requested experiment type
      pressures - pressure schedule in bara
      temperature - isothermal temperature in K
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any protocol value is invalid

    • value

      double value(ExperimentType requestedType, double pressure, double observationTemperature, int row, int property, double[] trialParameters)
      Return one observable from a complete trial experiment. Only successfully completed results enter the cache.
      Parameters:
      requestedType - type encoded in the observation
      pressure - observation pressure in bara
      observationTemperature - observation temperature in K
      row - original protocol row index
      property - observable index
      trialParameters - complete fitting-parameter vector
      Returns:
      the protocol-indexed simulated value
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if observation identity or parameter values are invalid
      IllegalStateException - if simulation results are missing or nonfinite
